records.residual: The clubs and contextual wood remain too regular and partly stylized. Fine cortex cracking, perithecial placement, basal mycelium, scattering and moisture response are incomplete. records.residual: Branch junctions intersect rather than reproduce a measured continuous tissue union; the remaining fork is still regular. Basal hairs, exact nodules, conidiophores, perithecial walls and ascus microanatomy are incomplete. The prepared white core and ring walls are diagrammatic and unmeasured. Material response, hair density, natural stages, spore dimensions and flow are not calibrated. Close foci are partial anatomy views, and the edge-on front view occludes structures. This selected mature study is not a complete species-complex identification or life-cycle simulation.
